visualCharacteristics.purpose: Air Dolomiti manage booking: surname and booking code, retrieved through api.airdolomiti.it and handed to its booking engine
traits: beige box in a centred 720px column
teal centred button with a chevron

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value, every row optional: Surname label, Surname placeholder, Booking code label, Booking code placeholder, Submit label, Error, Live page (link)

reuseGuidance: Air Dolomiti only (brand airdolomiti); change labels only. The API calls and the hand-off are in scripts/airdolomiti-api.js.
